steps.name: recover-stage13-parameter-count
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=f4700a6ba9f22e13cf1b35fff6d28424f5807711; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -n "$(git status --porcelain)"; test -z "$(git diff --cached --name-only)"; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path('schemas/environment-controller.v6.json').read_text())
assert d['model']['feature_count'] == 44
assert len(d['model']['features']) == 44
assert 'assert model.input_shape == (None, 44)' in Path('tests/test_climate_training.py').read_text()
assert 'expected_params = hidden_units * hidden_units + 46 * hidden_units + 6' in Path('tools/ml/climate_training.py').read_text()
PY
git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage13/fix_stage13_parameter_count.py > /tmp/fix-stage13-parameter-count.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/fix-stage13-parameter-count.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage13-observability-recovery
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py --check; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mvp_contract_v6.py tests/test_climate_input.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training_weighted.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_dagger_distributed.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py -q; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R climate_v6_tests --output-on-failure; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage13-recovery
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add effective actuator observability'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
